title: rag-pipeline configuration (.ragrc.json)
description: Configuration read by the rag-pipeline CLI and loadRagConfig() in @devilsdev/rag-pipeline-utils. Each pipeline entry names a built-in component, a custom module under "plugins", or a plugin registered on pluginRegistry.

pipeline.description: Components in pipeline order. At least an embedder and a retriever are needed for ingest and query.

plugins.description: Custom plugin modules by stage and name. Paths are relative to the configuration file; the module exports a class (constructed with the entry's config) or an object.

additionalProperties.description: Path to the plugin module, e.g. "./plugins/my-llm.js".

performance.description: Optional performance settings, preserved for plugins and tooling.

observability.description: Optional logging and metrics settings, preserved for plugins and tooling.

name.description: Built-in names: loader "auto"; embedder "local", "openai", "ollama", "cohere"; retriever "file-store", "memory"; llm "openai", "anthropic", "ollama", "router" (cost-aware routing over other llms); reranker "scoring". Any other name must be declared under "plugins" or registered on pluginRegistry.

config.description: Options passed to the component's constructor, e.g. { "model": "gpt-4o-mini" } or { "path": ".rag/index.json" } for file-store. Do not put API keys here; use environment variables.

routerConfig.description: Options of the "router" llm: each query goes to the cheapest route that handles its class ("simple" or "complex").

fallback.description: When the chosen model fails, try the next cheapest route for the class.

expectedOutputTokens.description: Answer length used in the cost estimate.

name.description: An llm: a built-in name, a plugin under "plugins" or a registered plugin.

model.description: Model the route is priced by. Defaults to config.model, then the connector's default model.

handles.description: Query classes the route serves ("simple", "complex"). All classes when omitted.

pricing.description: USD per unit tokens, for a model not in the built-in price table.
